additions.site_identity_review: Phase 2 belongs to the existing A-zone site published on 22 October 2026 (thirty-eighth update) with Phase 1 as its only project. Both permits name the same development (万国数据中卫一体化绿色先进示范数据中心产业园A区, phases 一期 and 二期), lie at Xuanhe Town with Sandang Highway as their east boundary, and carry consecutive real-estate units in the same cadastral zone (Phase 1 640502105212GB00038W, Phase 2 GB00039W). The site's campus point is the area centroid of the one detailed-plan parcel bounded by Jingsan Road, Wanyun Road, the Sandang Highway corridor and Weiliu Road, which the existing precision note already describes as the two-phase A-zone campus (Phase 1 the south half to Weiliu Road, Phase 2 the north half to Wanyun Road, 15.32 + 14.68 ha against 29.91 ha traced). The thirty-eighth holds list exactly this Phase 2 because a second project could not be added to a site created in the same update; that reopen condition is now met.

status.summary: On 30 September 2026 the Zhongwei Natural Resources Bureau issued the construction-project planning permit (electronic supervision no. 6405022026GG0075620) to Ningxia Wanguo Shuwei Data Technology Co., Ltd. for A-zone Phase 2 of the Wanguo Data Zhongwei Integrated Green Advanced Demonstration Data Center Industrial Park at Xuanhe Town (193,908.83 m2 GFA), published as in effect on 10 October 2026. The 18 September scheme provides machine-room buildings, an office building, a complex building and diesel-generator buildings on 14.682 ha. No construction start, completion or operation is established; Phase 1 (permit 6405022026GG0074699, same day) is the existing separate project.
status.permit_reference: Zhongwei Natural Resources Bureau construction-project planning permit, electronic supervision no. 6405022026GG0075620, issued 2026-09-30 (post-issuance notice index 640501011/2026-00797, 2026-10-10); preceded by land-use planning permit 6405022026YG0024667 issued 2026-09-23 for the same real-estate unit 640502105212GB00039W00000000
status.permit_identity_review: The permit names 万国数据中卫一体化绿色先进示范数据中心产业园A区二期项目 with Ningxia Wanguo Shuwei Data Technology Co., Ltd. as builder, at Xuanhe Town bounded east by Sandang Highway, north by Wanyun Road and south by the adjoining A-zone land; its GFA (193,908.83 m2, 186,742.39 m2 counted) and builder match the 18 September Phase 2 scheme board (machine-room buildings, office, complex and diesel-generator buildings; tallest building a 27.9 m machine-room building; 14.682 ha). A construction-project planning permit authorises the building works of the data-centre phase itself, not ancillary grid works. Validity is marked effective; no suspension or appeal was found.

locator.identity_review: Reuses the existing A-zone campus point exactly: the area centroid of the official Xuanhe detailed-plan parcel bounded by Jingsan Road, Wanyun Road, the Sandang Highway corridor and Weiliu Road, with its pinned detailed-plan geometry evidence. The baseline project has no geometry-identity evidence, so none is pinned. The existing precision note states that the point locates the two-phase A-zone campus and not either half; Phase 2 is the north half of that parcel, up to about 400 m from the point. The point does not locate a Phase 2 building.

status.summary: On 20 October 2026 the Shapotou District Branch of the Zhongwei Market Supervision Administration reported that its Xuanhe office, serving workers on the key data-centre projects under construction in Xuanhe (数据中心重点在建项目), had contacted the China Mobile, CIDC and Zhonglian (中联) project leaders and guided the building of construction-site canteens, and would keep supervising canteens at projects under construction. In Xuanhe Town the Zhonglian project is the Zhonglian Zero-Carbon Intelligent Computing (Xuanhe) Industrial Park, whose June 2026 substation EIA already described the park as formally under construction (site enclosed and levelled, a camp of over 11,000 m2 built). The record names no zone or building: it supports construction of the park development as a whole, not the stage of any building, and no completion or operation is established.

locator.precision: EIA centre point of the park's own 330 kV substation, which the report places on reserved land on the west side of the Zhonglian Xuanhe compute-centre industrial park, beside the No.2 data-centre building. Locates the park through on-campus support infrastructure; not a data-centre building footprint, parcel centroid, entrance or construction extent. The park (A-zone and B-zone, about 34 ha) extends up to about 650 m east and south of the point.
locator.identity_review: The report form (accepted by the Zhongwei EEB on 9 June 2026) names 中联零碳智算（宣和）产业园A区项目330千伏变电站工程, built by Ningxia Western Intelligent Computing Big Data Technology Co., Ltd. at Wangyuan Village, Xuanhe Town, and states that the station lies inside the park on its west side. The park permits bound both zones west by Sandang Highway. Printed 105°29′25.851″, 37°22′6.045″ transcribed arithmetically. Read as WGS84, the point lies on the west edge of the data-centre block bounded by the Sandang Highway auxiliary road, Weisi Road, Jingwu Road and Weiwu Road on the registered official Xuanhe detailed plan, within about 50 m of the substation position on the 17 September 2026 A-zone board, and about 40 m west of the levelled park ground in the 2025 Sentinel-2 mosaic; the GCJ-02 alternative would fall in gully land west of Sandang Highway, contradicting the permits. The separate Zhonglian Cloud Base park lies in the Zhongwei Industrial Park, about 32 km away. Details: sources/research-countries-2026-10-23-cn-ningxia-gansu-p2-xuanhe-eia-substations-geometry-facts.json.
locator.uncertainty_reason: No datum or positional accuracy is stated. The WGS84 reading is supported by agreement within about 50 m with the official site board placed on the registered detailed plan (itself about 5 m RMS image-to-image against imagery of unstated accuracy) and by the levelled ground in the 2025 Sentinel-2 mosaic. Estimated within roughly 100 m of the planned substation centre; the point may fall on the park's west edge or access strip. Decimal places are transcription precision, not accuracy.

status.summary: On 20 October 2026 the Shapotou District Branch of the Zhongwei Market Supervision Administration reported that its Xuanhe office, serving workers on the key data-centre projects under construction in Xuanhe (数据中心重点在建项目), had contacted the China Mobile, CIDC (中金) and Zhonglian project leaders and guided the building of construction-site canteens, and would keep supervising canteens at projects under construction. In Xuanhe Town the CIDC project is the CIDC Zhongwei Green Intelligent Computing Industrial Base, whose March 2026 substation EIA already described the base as under construction. The record names no phase or building: it supports construction of the Phases 1-2 development as a whole, not the stage of any compute centre, and no completion or operation is established.

locator.precision: EIA centre point of the base's own Phases 1-2 330 kV substation, which the report places inside the CIDC Xuanhe base site with base land to its north and west. Locates the base through on-campus support infrastructure, in the south-east part of the Phase 1 site; not a compute-centre footprint, parcel centroid, entrance or construction extent. The Phase 1 site extends up to about 500 m from the point and Phase 2 land lies beyond it.
locator.identity_review: The report form (accepted by the Zhongwei EEB on 11 March 2026) names 中金数据中卫绿色智算产业基地一期、二期330千伏变电站工程, built by CIDC (Zhongwei) Technology Co., Ltd. at Xuanhe Town, and states that the station lies inside the base site (厂区内). Printed 105°29′53.933″, 37°22′42.025″ transcribed arithmetically; the special assessment repeats it to 0.00001″ with four station-boundary points 57-104 m away. Read as WGS84, the point lies in the south-east part of the data-centre block bounded by the Sandang Highway auxiliary road, Weier Road and Jingsi Road on the registered official Xuanhe detailed plan, within about 25 m of the 330 kV substation on the November 2025 Phase 1 board; the official 19 October 2026 roads scheme labels CIDC gates (中金大门) on this block, including the freight gate on Weier Road at the position of the board's south freight entrance. The GCJ-02 alternative would fall on Weier Road at the block's south-west corner, contradicting the report. CIDC's West Cloud Base campus (thirty-fourth hold) is a different site about 32 km away. Details: sources/research-countries-2026-10-23-cn-ningxia-gansu-p2-xuanhe-eia-substations-geometry-facts.json. The special assessment also prints, in its section 1.1, a second station centre (105°29′48.314″, 37°22′46.293″) about 190 m north-west of the selected value; it is not selected because the selected value is printed twice in the main report, equals the special assessment's own station-centre monitoring point 5# and is bracketed by its four station-boundary points, and matches the Phase 1 board, while the section 1.1 value does not. Both values fall inside the same CIDC block. The 2025 board labels the south road 纬三路; the 2026 plan and roads scheme name it 纬二路 (Weier Road).
locator.uncertainty_reason: No datum or positional accuracy is stated. The WGS84 reading is supported by agreement within about 25 m with the official Phase 1 board placed on the registered detailed plan (itself about 5 m RMS image-to-image against imagery of unstated accuracy), by the report's own station-centre and station-boundary monitoring coordinates and by the official gate labels; the 2025 imagery predates construction, so no direct imagery check was possible. Estimated within roughly 60 m of the substation centre, but because the special assessment also prints a conflicting centre about 190 m north-west (inside the same block), an error of up to about 200 m cannot be excluded. Decimal places are transcription precision, not accuracy.

additions.name: ODATA DC BG01 — existing data-centre operations

status.summary: ODATA's Colombia locations page, in its version of 25 September 2026 (dateModified 2026-09-25T12:39:31Z; the version was already current in ODATA's sitemap archived on 13 October 2026 and unchanged at capture on 23 October), states that 'El centro de datos BG01 está operativo y cuenta con capacidad disponible' for cloud, AI and other critical digital operations, and lists Centro de datos BG01 at Zona Franca Metropolitana Cota, Edificio San Rafael, Vereda Vuelta Grande, Cota (Cundinamarca) with 'Disponibilidad 24/7/365 / Acceso y funcionamiento continuos'. ODATA's archived BG01 facility page lists Tier III Facility and operations certifications, and its October 2024 press note says BG01 was inaugurated earlier. This records the existing BG01 data centre as operating on 25 September 2026, the modification day of the captured version, not an inspection or opening date. Capacity in service and occupancy are not established; the separately announced BG02 (Mosquera) and BG03 (Tenjo) campuses are not part of this record.

locator.precision: ODATA's own locations-map coordinate for 'ODATA DC BG01' (Zona Franca Metropolitana, Cota), used as the locator of the BG01 campus. In Esri World Imagery it falls at the north-west corner of a white-roofed building at an estate-road junction, beside a block carrying dense rooftop mechanical plant. It does not give the building footprint, lot boundary or entrance. Which of the adjoining buildings houses BG01 is not established: the operator figures (6,400 m2 total area, 5,500 m2 built) are smaller than the white-roofed building and the plant-roofed block together, and the point lies roughly 80 m from the plant-roofed block.
locator.identity_review: Store-locator entry id 8625 'ODATA DC BG01' on ODATA's locations page pairs the literal coordinate '4.7552422,-74.1388944' with the Zona Franca Metropolitana, Cota address; the Colombia locations page names the same facility at Zona Franca Metropolitana Cota, Edificio/Predio San Rafael, Vereda Vuelta Grande. The map link on ODATA's own archived BG01 page resolves to the Google Maps place 'ODATA DATA CENTER BG01' 29.1 m away, searched from the same Predio San Rafael address. Qualitative imagery check only (Esri World Imagery export captured 23 October 2026, acquisition date not stated). No geocoder was used; no official Cota parcel was retrieved.
locator.uncertainty_reason: ODATA states no datum or accuracy for its locator coordinates (WGS 84 assumed by the web map, not asserted), and no official parcel or address point was obtained; the point sits at the building corner and its decimal places are publication precision, not accuracy.

ODATA appears in the Atlas only for its Brazilian (SP01, SP02, SP04, RJ01) and Mexican (QR01 to QR03) sites; an earlier evidence row cites SEA record PERTI-2023-16026 (ODATA's Lampa data centre) only as a distinctness reference for Campo de Datos Lampa; the 2026-10-16 holds list 'ODATA San Bernardo and Lampa' among SNIFA-registered Chilean data centres awaiting an operator or regulator record dated on or after 18 July 2026, which the 25 September 2026 Chile page now supplies for ST01 and ST02. ODATA's announced BG02 (Zona Franca de Occidente, Mosquera) and BG03 (Zona Franca Metropolitana, Tenjo) campuses are not in the Atlas, are not on the current Colombia page and are held in this fragment; BG01 is ODATA's existing facility in Cota.
